## Process lifecycle

- Run long-lived servers and watchers in a persistent session such as tmux.
- Do not background them in bounded commands without explicit detachment and cleanup.
- After a timeout, inspect the process and endpoint before retrying or claiming failure.

## Linux browser and WebGPU capture

- Use the preinstalled `playwright-cli` executable from Actions or SSH.
- Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
- Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
- Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.
- Run `playwright-cli screenshot --filename=screenshots/linux.png` after creating the output directory.
- Inspect the image. Reject loading screens, empty grids, and blank canvases.
- Report SwiftShader as CPU software rendering. Do not claim GPU hardware acceleration.
- Inspect `$HOME/.local/share/omgithub-playwright/linux.json` for launch settings.
- Use `playwright-cli --help` for commands and named sessions. Pass configuration only to `open`.

## Mobile browser games

- Support Android and iOS phones and tablets with responsive layouts and usable touch controls.
- Keep gameplay and controls visible within safe areas and avoid browser gesture conflicts.
- Add tilt controls only when appropriate; offer touch alternatives and request iOS motion permission from a user gesture when needed.
- Follow explicit device and control requirements in the user request.

# 🤯 OMG — Oh My GitHub ### 🚀 One Prompt In. A Full Game or App Out. 🚀 [![Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/status-🔥%20works-brightgreen?style=for-the-badge)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![GitHub Issues](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/denaidark/OhMyGithub?style=for-the-badge&logo=github)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/issues) [![GitHub Actions](https://img.shields.io/badge/GitHub%20Actions-automated-2088FF?style=for-the-badge&logo=githubactions&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/denaidark/OhMyGithub/actions) [![OpenCode](https://img.shields.io/badge/powered%20by-OpenCode-111111?style=for-the-badge)](https://opencode.ai/) ```text ╔══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╗ ║ DESCRIBE IT → BUILD IT → TEST IT → PLAY IT ║ ║ ║ ║ One GitHub issue. One prompt. A complete project. ║ ╚══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════╝ ``` **No API keys to configure. No server to maintain. No local setup maze.**
--- ## 🤯 What Is OMG? > **Your GitHub issue becomes the product brief.** OMG (Oh My GitHub) is an automated GitHub Actions workflow for creating complete browser games and app projects from one natural-language prompt. Write what you want in an issue and add the `OpenCode` label. OpenCode checks out the project, uses the shared skills, builds the experience, runs tests, verifies the result, and publishes an immutable OmGithub project link from the finished commit. Yes, it creates the code. Yes, it runs the verification loop. Yes, it can expose the result in a temporary browser URL. ## 🧠 TL;DR 1. Open a GitHub issue. 2. Describe the game or app you want. 3. Add the `OpenCode` label to the issue. 4. Let GitHub Actions build, test, verify, and propose the result. ```text Your idea → GitHub issue → OpenCode → tests → immutable OmGithub project ``` ## ⚡ Quick Start Create an issue in your repository with a concrete request: ```text Build a neon asteroid game. Requirements: - Arrow-key movement - Score and restart button - Win and lose states - Responsive browser layout - Run tests and verify it in a browser ``` That is the whole user-facing workflow. GitHub Actions handles the runner, OpenCode handles implementation, and the workflow handles verification plus the immutable project commit. To run against an existing non-default branch, end the issue title with a `branch: ` directive. The directive selects the checkout and is removed before the issue body is sent to OpenCode: ```sh gh issue create \ --repo denaidark/OhMyGithub \ --title "Custom branch smoke test branch: codex/omgithub-site" \ --body "Build a tiny browser page." \ --label Goal \ --label OpenCode ``` The GitHub App validates the branch before dispatching. If the directive is absent, the repository default branch remains the target. ## 🌍 What Can You Build? | 🎯 Use case | ✨ Example | |---|---| | 🎮 Arcade games | Breakout, Space Invaders, Asteroids, Match-3 | | 🧩 Puzzle games | Word games, logic puzzles, card games | | 🏃 Interactive demos | Physics experiments, simulations, visual toys | | 📊 Dashboards | Filters, charts, status panels, analytics views | | 🛠️ Internal tools | Trackers, generators, small workflow apps | | 🌐 Landing pages | Product pages, portfolios, interactive showcases | | 🧪 Prototypes | Turn a product idea into a runnable proof of concept | | 📱 Browser apps | Responsive tools that work on desktop and mobile | ## 🧰 What Happens Automatically? > **The workflow is the product.** - 📥 Checks out your repository and the shared OpenCode skills. - 🏷️ Synchronizes `model/*` and `skill/*` labels. - 🧭 Reads issue labels to select the model and requested skills. - 🤖 Runs OpenCode against the current project. - 🧪 Runs a second verification prompt after implementation. - 🌐 Starts the app and checks the local runtime. - 🔗 Creates a temporary public preview URL when verification passes. - 🔀 Creates and pushes an `opencode/` branch. - 🕹️ Adds an `Open Project` link backed by the repository path, with full-commit links retained for compatibility. - 💬 Posts progress and access details back to the issue. - 🧹 Cleans up temporary tunnels and runner processes. ## 🏷️ Model and Skill Labels Labels let you control the workflow without editing YAML. ```text model/opencode/deepseek-v4.1-flash-free skill/load-sketchfab-threejs skill/gauntlet-loop ``` The workflow validates the selected labels, passes them into OpenCode, and records the resolved model and skills in the run logs. Shared skills are discovered from: ```text .agents/skills//SKILL.md ``` ## 🔄 OpenCode Workflow ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Trigger] --> B[Prepare project] B --> C[Run build.md] C --> D[Run verify.md] D --> E{Public app works?} E -- No --> F[Run public-app-fix.md] F --> E E -- Yes --> G[Run completion-report.md] G --> H{Screenshots exist?} H -- No --> I[Run screenshot-evidence.md] I --> H H -- Yes --> J[Commit and push] J --> K[Create immutable project link] K --> L[Publish report] L --> M[Complete] ``` ## 🏗️ Architecture ```text ┌──────────────┐ ┌─────────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ │ GitHub issue │ ──▶ │ GitHub Actions │ ──▶ │ OpenCode │ │ + issue text │ │ runner + labels │ │ + .agents │ └──────────────┘ └─────────────────┘ └──────┬───────┘ │ ┌─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┐ ▼ ▼ ▼ Build code Run tests Verify app │ │ │ └─────────────────────┼─────────────────────┘ ▼ ┌────────────────────────┐ │ Commit store + preview │ └────────────────────────┘ ``` ## 🔐 Security and Access - 🔑 You do not need to create or store a project-specific AI API key. - 🖥️ You do not need to operate a dedicated build server. - ☁️ Execution happens in GitHub Actions. - 🔒 Temporary SSH and preview access exists only for the workflow run. - 👀 Review the generated commit before integrating it. - 🛡️ Restrict who can apply the `OpenCode` label in repositories that accept public issues. > “No servers needed” means no servers for you to provision or maintain. The workflow still uses GitHub-hosted Actions infrastructure and temporary workflow services. ## 📁 Project Structure ```text 📦 OMG ├─ .github/workflows/opencode.yml # 🤖 Main issue-to-project workflow ├─ wiki/opencode.md # 📖 Workflow and session notes ├─ wiki/testing.md # 🧪 Verification guidance └─ AGENTS.md # 🧭 Repository instructions ``` ## 🧪 Local Validation Validate the workflow definition before pushing changes: ```sh actionlint .github/workflows/opencode.yml git diff --check ``` ## 🐛 Troubleshooting | Problem | What to check | |---|---| | The workflow did not start | Confirm the `OpenCode` label is applied to the issue. | | A skill was not selected | Add a matching `skill/` label. | | The app URL is missing | Check the local app verification step and runner log. | | The PR was not created | Confirm OpenCode produced a diff and the workflow reached the PR step. | | The workflow ran unexpectedly | Tighten the trigger condition and trusted-user policy. | ## 🤝 Contributing Ideas, skills, game templates, verification improvements, and workflow fixes are welcome. 1. function mkFamily(seed, index) {
  const [id, names, element, rarity, shape, palette, habitat, base, sig, lore] = seed
  return {
    id, names, element, rarity, shape, palette, habitat, base, sig, lore,
    index,
    evoLevels: [16, 36],
  }
}

export const FAMILIES = FAMILY_SEED.map(mkFamily)
export const MYTHICS = MYTHIC_SEED.map((seed, i) => ({
  ...mkFamily(seed, 50 + i),
  names: [seed[1]],
  mythic: true,
  evoLevels: [],
}))

export const CREATURES = []
export const CREATURE_BY_ID = {}

function buildMoves(family, stage) {
  const element = family.element
  const pool = ELEMENT_POOL[element]
  const support = ['fortaleza', 'furia', 'brisa', 'sanacion', 'marca', 'escudo']
  const sigId = `sig_${family.id}_${stage + 1}`
  const sigNames = family.mythic
    ? [family.sig]
    : [
        `${family.sig} de ${family.names[0]}`,
        `${family.sig} Mayor`,
        `${family.sig} Cataclísmica`,
      ]
  TECHNIQUES[sigId] = {
    id: sigId, name: sigNames[stage], element, kind: 'attack', tier: 4 + stage,
    power: 72 + stage * 28, cost: 12 + stage * 5, accuracy: 92,
    desc: `Técnica de linaje de ${family.names[stage]}. El vínculo aumenta su poder.`,
    icon: ELEMENTS[element].icon, signature: true, scaling: true,
  }
  const learnset = [
    { level: 1, id: `${element}_1` },
    { level: 3, id: support[family.index % support.length] },
    { level: 7, id: `${element}_2` },
    { level: 11, id: sigId },
    { level: 18, id: `${element}_3` },
    { level: 24, id: support[(family.index + 2) % support.length] },
    { level: 34, id: `${element}_4` },
    { level: 46, id: `${element}_5` },
    { level: 60, id: `${element}_nexo` },
    { level: 80, id: support[(family.index + 4) % support.length] },
  ]
  if (stage > 0) {
    learnset.push({ level: 16, id: `sig_${family.id}_2` })
    learnset.push({ level: 36, id: `sig_${family.id}_3` })
  }
  return learnset
}

function statsFor(base, level, stage, rarity) {
  const stageMult = [1, 1.28, 1.6][stage]
  const rarityMult = RARITIES[rarity].mult
  return {
    hp: Math.round((base[0] * 2.1 + level * 6.4) * stageMult * rarityMult),
    atk: Math.round((base[1] + level * 1.85) * stageMult * rarityMult),
    def: Math.round((base[2] + level * 1.55) * stageMult * rarityMult),
    spd: Math.round((base[3] + level * 1.35) * stageMult * rarityMult),
  }
}

function registerCreature(family, stage) {
  const isMythic = !!family.mythic
  const id = isMythic ? family.id : `${family.id}-${stage + 1}`
  const name = family.names[stage]
  const prev = stage > 0 ? `${family.id}-${stage}` : null
  const next = !isMythic && stage < family.names.length - 1 ? `${family.id}-${stage + 2}` : null
  const evoLevel = stage < family.evoLevels.length ? family.evoLevels[stage] : null
  const record = {
    id, name, family: family.id, stage, prev, next, evoLevel,
    element: family.element, rarity: family.rarity, shape: family.shape,
    palette: family.palette, habitat: family.habitat, lore: family.lore,
    base: family.base, sig: family.sig, mythic: isMythic,
    learnset: buildMoves(family, stage),
    statsAt: (level) => statsFor(family.base, level, stage, family.rarity),
  }
  CREATURES.push(record)
  CREATURE_BY_ID[id] = record
  return record
}

for (const family of FAMILIES) {
  for (let stage = 0; stage < family.names.length; stage++) registerCreature(family, stage)
}
for (const family of MYTHICS) registerCreature(family, 0)

import {
  CREATURE_BY_ID, ELEMENTS, POIS, RARITIES, WORLD, ZONES, ZONE_BY_ID,
} from './data.js'
import { clamp, isNight, rand, shadeColor } from './core.js'

const TAU = Math.PI * 2

export function seeded(seed) {
  let a = seed >>> 0
  return () => {
    a |= 0
    a = (a + 0x6D2B79F5) | 0
    let t = Math.imul(a ^ (a >>> 15), 1 | a)
    t = (t + Math.imul(t ^ (t >>> 7), 61 | t)) ^ t
    return ((t ^ (t >>> 14)) >>> 0) / 4294967296
  }
}

function ellipse(ctx, x, y, rx, ry, fill) {
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.ellipse(x, y, rx, ry, 0, 0, TAU)
  if (fill) ctx.fill()
}

function bodyGradient(ctx, x, y, rx, ry, palette) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x - rx * 0.35, y - ry * 0.5, rx * 0.08, x, y, rx * 1.15)
  g.addColorStop(0, shadeColor(palette[0], 34))
  g.addColorStop(0.5, palette[0])
  g.addColorStop(1, palette[1])
  return g
}

function aura(ctx, x, y, r, species, time, intensity = 1) {
  const rarity = RARITIES[species.rarity]
  const pulse = 0.86 + Math.sin(time * 2.2 + x * 0.01) * 0.14
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y - r * 0.15, r * 0.15, x, y - r * 0.1, r * 1.65)
  g.addColorStop(0, rarity.aura)
  g.addColorStop(0.55, rarity.aura.replace(/[\d.]+\)$/, `${0.12 * intensity})`))
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
  ctx.save()
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'
  ctx.globalAlpha = pulse
  ellipse(ctx, x, y - r * 0.1, r * 1.45, r * 1.1, g)
  ctx.restore()

  if (species.rarity === 'legendario' || species.rarity === 'mitico' || species.stage === 2) {
    ctx.save()
    ctx.translate(x, y - r * 0.2)
    ctx.rotate(time * 0.12)
    ctx.strokeStyle = rarity.color
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.18 + Math.sin(time * 1.7) * 0.05
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.018)
    ctx.setLineDash([r * 0.12, r * 0.12])
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r * 1.25, r * 0.48, 0, 0, TAU)
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.rotate(-time * 0.25)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, r * 1.05, r * 0.38, 0.7, 0, TAU)
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.restore()
  }
}

function eye(ctx, x, y, r, look = 0, glow = '#fff') {
  ellipse(ctx, x, y, r, r * 1.16, '#f8fafc')
  ellipse(ctx, x + look * r * 0.22, y + r * 0.06, r * 0.56, r * 0.7, '#111827')
  ellipse(ctx, x + look * r * 0.12 - r * 0.2, y - r * 0.3, r * 0.22, r * 0.22, glow)
}

function drawFace(ctx, x, y, r, species, opts) {
  const p = species.palette
  const eyeR = r * 0.11
  const look = opts.facing || 1
  if (species.shape === 'golem') {
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.85
    ctx.fillRect(x - r * 0.24, y - r * 0.18, r * 0.12, r * 0.055)
    ctx.fillRect(x + r * 0.12, y - r * 0.18, r * 0.12, r * 0.055)
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[1]
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.025)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(x - r * 0.1, y + r * 0.12)
    ctx.lineTo(x, y + r * 0.17)
    ctx.lineTo(x + r * 0.1, y + r * 0.12)
    ctx.stroke()
    return
  }
  if (species.shape === 'slime') {
    eye(ctx, x - r * 0.18, y - r * 0.04, eyeR * 1.15, look)
    eye(ctx, x + r * 0.18, y - r * 0.04, eyeR * 1.15, look)
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#111827'
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.025)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(x, y + r * 0.12, r * 0.11, 0.2, Math.PI - 0.2)
    ctx.stroke()
    return
  }
  const spacing = species.shape === 'insect' ? r * 0.21 : r * 0.16
  eye(ctx, x - spacing, y - r * 0.03, eyeR, look)
  eye(ctx, x + spacing, y - r * 0.03, eyeR, look)
  ctx.strokeStyle = species.palette[1]
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.022)
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(x - r * 0.06, y + r * 0.13)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x, y + r * 0.17, x + r * 0.06, y + r * 0.13)
  ctx.stroke()
  if (species.rarity === 'legendario' || species.rarity === 'mitico') {
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[2]
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.6
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(x - r * 0.2, y - r * 0.13)
    ctx.lineTo(x - r * 0.05, y - r * 0.18)
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(x + r * 0.2, y - r * 0.13)
    ctx.lineTo(x + r * 0.05, y - r * 0.18)
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  }
}

function drawHorns(ctx, x, y, r, species, scale = 1) {
  const p = species.palette
  const horn = p[2]
  ctx.fillStyle = horn
  ctx.strokeStyle = p[1]
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.018)
  const dirs = species.shape === 'beast' || species.shape === 'dragon' ? [-1, 1] : [1]
  for (const dir of dirs) {
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(x + dir * r * 0.22 * scale, y - r * 0.3 * scale)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + dir * r * 0.43 * scale, y - r * 0.52 * scale, x + dir * r * 0.33 * scale, y - r * 0.7 * scale)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + dir * r * 0.27 * scale, y - r * 0.48 * scale, x + dir * r * 0.12 * scale, y - r * 0.35 * scale)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.stroke()
  }
}

function drawWings(ctx, x, y, r, species, time, side = 1) {
  const p = species.palette
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(x, y - r * 0.15)
  ctx.scale(side, 1)
  const flap = Math.sin(time * 2.6) * 0.1
  ctx.rotate(-0.18 + flap)
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, r * 0.9, -r * 0.2)
  g.addColorStop(0, p[0])
  g.addColorStop(0.65, p[1])
  g.addColorStop(1, p[2])
  ctx.fillStyle = g
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.92
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(r * 0.08, 0)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.5, -r * 0.72, r * 0.98, -r * 0.46)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.68, -r * 0.2, r * 0.78, r * 0.02)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.5, -r * 0.04, r * 0.52, r * 0.24)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.28, r * 0.02, r * 0.08, r * 0.16)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.38
  ctx.strokeStyle = p[2]
  ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.016)
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(r * 0.12, 0)
    ctx.lineTo(r * (0.5 + i * 0.12), -r * (0.44 - i * 0.1))
    ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawTail(ctx, x, y, r, species, time, side = -1) {
  const p = species.palette
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(x + side * r * 0.35, y + r * 0.08)
  ctx.rotate(side * (0.3 + Math.sin(time * 1.5) * 0.1))
  ctx.strokeStyle = p[1]
  ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.12
  ctx.lineCap = 'round'
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(0, 0)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(side * r * 0.28, -r * 0.14, side * r * 0.52, -r * 0.28)
  ctx.stroke()
  if (species.shape === 'dragon' || species.rarity === 'legendario' || species.rarity === 'mitico') {
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(side * r * 0.52, -r * 0.28)
    ctx.lineTo(side * r * 0.69, -r * 0.5)
    ctx.lineTo(side * r * 0.64, -r * 0.23)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawPattern(ctx, x, y, r, species, stage) {
  const p = species.palette
  const type = species.family.length % 4
  ctx.save()
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35
  ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
  if (type === 0) {
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.ellipse(x + i * r * 0.19, y - r * 0.02, r * 0.035, r * 0.13, -0.3, 0, TAU)
      ctx.fill()
    }
  } else if (type === 1) {
    for (let i = 0; i < 4 + stage * 2; i++) {
      const a = i * 2.1
      ellipse(ctx, x + Math.cos(a) * r * (0.18 + (i % 3) * 0.06), y + Math.sin(a) * r * 0.14, r * 0.027, r * 0.027, p[2])
    }
  } else if (type === 2) {
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[2]
    ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.022)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(x - r * 0.15, y - r * 0.18)
    ctx.lineTo(x - r * 0.04, y - r * 0.03)
    ctx.lineTo(x - r * 0.11, y + r * 0.08)
    ctx.moveTo(x + r * 0.12, y - r * 0.2)
    ctx.lineTo(x + r * 0.22, y - r * 0.02)
    ctx.stroke()
  } else {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(x, y - r * 0.02, r * (0.16 + i * 0.08), 0.2, 1.2)
      ctx.strokeStyle = p[2]
      ctx.lineWidth = Math.max(1, r * 0.014)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawBodyBeast(ctx, r, p, time) {
  const bob = Math.sin(time * 1.8) * r * 0.015
  ctx.fillStyle = p[1]
  for (const [lx, ly] of [[-0.32, 0.34], [-0.16, 0.36], [0.18, 0.36], [0.34, 0.33]]) {
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.roundRect(lx * r - r * 0.06, (ly + bob) * r, r * 0.13, r * 0.3, r * 0.05)
    ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, 0, r * 0.48, r * 0.34, p)
  ellipse(ctx, 0, bob, r * 0.47, r * 0.32)
  ellipse(ctx, r * 0.38, -r * 0.28 + bob, r * 0.24, r * 0.23, bodyGradient(ctx, r * 0.38, -r * 0.28, r * 0.24, r * 0.23, p))
  // ears
  ctx.fillStyle = p[1]
  for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(r * 0.38 + d * r * 0.13, -r * 0.46)
    ctx.lineTo(r * 0.38 + d * r * 0.24, -r * 0.62)
    ctx.lineTo(r * 0.38 + d * r * 0.28, -r * 0.4)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
  }
  drawFace(ctx, r * 0.43, -r * 0.27, r * 0.24, { ...arguments[4] }, { facing: 1 })
}

function drawCreatureShape(ctx, species, r, time, opts) {
  const p = species.palette
  const stage = species.stage
  const bob = Math.sin(time * 1.8 + (opts.seed || 0)) * r * 0.014
  const shape = species.shape

  if (shape === 'beast') {
    ctx.fillStyle = p[1]
    for (const [lx, ly] of [[-0.32, 0.3], [-0.16, 0.34], [0.16, 0.34], [0.32, 0.3]]) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.roundRect(lx * r - r * 0.055, (ly + bob) * r, r * 0.12, r * 0.3, r * 0.05)
      ctx.fill()
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, 0, r * 0.46, r * 0.32, p)
    ellipse(ctx, 0, bob, r * 0.46, r * 0.31)
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, r * 0.34, -r * 0.26 + bob, r * 0.25, r * 0.24, p)
    ellipse(ctx, r * 0.34, -r * 0.27 + bob, r * 0.25, r * 0.23)
    ctx.fillStyle = p[1]
    for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(r * 0.34 + d * r * 0.13, -r * 0.43)
      ctx.lineTo(r * 0.34 + d * r * 0.24, -r * 0.61)
      ctx.lineTo(r * 0.34 + d * r * 0.28, -r * 0.38)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill()
    }
    drawFace(ctx, r * 0.4, -r * 0.25, r * 0.24, species, opts)
    drawTail(ctx, 0, bob, r, species, time, -1)
    drawHorns(ctx, r * 0.34, -r * 0.29, r, species, 0.9)
  } else if (shape === 'dragon') {
    drawWings(ctx, 0, 0, r, species, time, -1)
    drawWings(ctx, 0, 0, r, species, time, 1)
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, 0, r * 0.4, r * 0.34, p)
    ellipse(ctx, 0, bob, r * 0.38, r * 0.32)
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[1]
    ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.15
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(r * 0.2, -r * 0.16 + bob)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.34, -r * 0.42, r * 0.32, -r * 0.53 + bob)
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, r * 0.33, -r * 0.57, r * 0.24, r * 0.22, p)
    ellipse(ctx, r * 0.34, -r * 0.56 + bob, r * 0.24, r * 0.21)
    ctx.fillStyle = p[1]
    for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(r * 0.35 + d * r * 0.11, -r * 0.73)
      ctx.lineTo(r * 0.35 + d * r * 0.21, -r * 0.92)
      ctx.lineTo(r * 0.35 + d * r * 0.25, -r * 0.69)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill()
    }
    drawFace(ctx, r * 0.39, -r * 0.55, r * 0.23, species, opts)
    drawTail(ctx, 0, bob, r, species, time, -1)
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    for (let i = 0; i < 3 + stage; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.2 + i * r * 0.12, -r * 0.26)
      ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.15 + i * r * 0.12, -r * 0.4 - i * r * 0.02)
      ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.1 + i * r * 0.12, -r * 0.26)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill()
    }
  } else if (shape === 'bird') {
    drawWings(ctx, 0, -r * 0.02, r * 1.05, species, time, -1)
    drawWings(ctx, 0, -r * 0.02, r * 1.05, species, time, 1)
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, 0, r * 0.34, r * 0.4, p)
    ellipse(ctx, 0, bob, r * 0.34, r * 0.4)
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, -r * 0.4 + bob, r * 0.22, r * 0.2, p)
    ellipse(ctx, 0, -r * 0.4 + bob, r * 0.22, r * 0.2)
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.06, -r * 0.36)
    ctx.lineTo(r * 0.24, -r * 0.3)
    ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.05, -r * 0.24)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    drawFace(ctx, 0, -r * 0.43, r * 0.21, species, opts)
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
      ctx.save()
      ctx.translate(i * r * 0.12, r * 0.34)
      ctx.rotate(i * 0.22)
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(0, 0)
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-r * 0.05, r * 0.28, r * 0.02, r * 0.4)
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.1, r * 0.2, 0, 0)
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.restore()
    }
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[2]
    ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.035
    for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(d * r * 0.09, r * 0.33)
      ctx.lineTo(d * r * 0.12, r * 0.52)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
  } else if (shape === 'slime') {
    const squish = Math.sin(time * 2.1) * 0.025
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, 0, r * 0.54, r * 0.4, p)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.52, r * 0.28)
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-r * 0.58, -r * 0.25, -r * 0.25, -r * 0.52, 0, -r * 0.48)
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(r * 0.28, -r * 0.52, r * 0.58, -r * 0.2, r * 0.52, r * 0.3)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.32, r * 0.42 + squish * r, 0, r * 0.38)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-r * 0.32, r * 0.44 - squish * r, -r * 0.52, r * 0.28)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    ellipse(ctx, -r * 0.18, -r * 0.2, r * 0.12, r * 0.08, p[2])
    ellipse(ctx, r * 0.2, r * 0.05, r * 0.06, r * 0.04, p[2])
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    drawFace(ctx, 0, -r * 0.04, r * 0.4, species, opts)
  } else if (shape === 'golem') {
    ctx.fillStyle = p[1]
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.roundRect(-r * 0.34, -r * 0.08, r * 0.22, r * 0.42, r * 0.06)
    ctx.roundRect(r * 0.12, -r * 0.08, r * 0.22, r * 0.42, r * 0.06)
    ctx.roundRect(-r * 0.42, r * 0.28, r * 0.25, r * 0.18, r * 0.06)
    ctx.roundRect(r * 0.17, r * 0.28, r * 0.25, r * 0.18, r * 0.06)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, -r * 0.05, r * 0.45, r * 0.42, p)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.roundRect(-r * 0.4, -r * 0.38, r * 0.8, r * 0.66, r * 0.13)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, -r * 0.54, r * 0.25, r * 0.22, p)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.roundRect(-r * 0.25, -r * 0.7, r * 0.5, r * 0.36, r * 0.1)
    ctx.fill()
    // crystal core
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    ctx.shadowColor = p[2]
    ctx.shadowBlur = r * 0.25
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, -r * 0.25)
    ctx.lineTo(r * 0.13, -r * 0.08)
    ctx.lineTo(0, r * 0.12)
    ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.13, -r * 0.08)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0
    drawFace(ctx, 0, -r * 0.53, r * 0.22, species, opts)
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[2]
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4
    ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.02
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.3 + i * r * 0.25, -r * 0.33)
      ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.22 + i * r * 0.25, -r * 0.12)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  } else if (shape === 'spirit') {
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.88
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, -r * 0.08, r * 0.36, r * 0.44, p)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, -r * 0.55)
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(r * 0.45, -r * 0.45, r * 0.42, r * 0.05, r * 0.18, r * 0.16)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.08, r * 0.45, -r * 0.04, r * 0.28)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-r * 0.2, r * 0.48, -r * 0.22, r * 0.15)
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-r * 0.46, -r * 0.1, -r * 0.36, -r * 0.5, 0, -r * 0.55)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    // mask
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(0, -r * 0.22, r * 0.26, r * 0.18, 0, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    drawFace(ctx, 0, -r * 0.24, r * 0.23, species, opts)
    for (let i = 0; i < 4 + stage * 2; i++) {
      const a = time * 0.7 + i * 1.7
      const px = Math.cos(a) * r * (0.45 + (i % 3) * 0.1)
      const py = Math.sin(a * 1.2) * r * 0.45 - r * 0.15
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.4 + Math.sin(time * 2 + i) * 0.2
      ellipse(ctx, px, py, r * 0.025, r * 0.025, p[2])
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  } else if (shape === 'insect') {
    ctx.fillStyle = p[1]
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      const y = r * (0.1 + i * 0.09)
      for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.moveTo(d * r * 0.16, y)
        ctx.lineTo(d * r * 0.45, y + r * 0.2)
        ctx.lineTo(d * r * 0.18, y + r * 0.04)
        ctx.closePath()
        ctx.fill()
      }
    }
    // wings
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.34
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.save()
      ctx.scale(d, 1)
      ctx.rotate(-0.25 + Math.sin(time * 8) * 0.06)
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.ellipse(r * 0.34, -r * 0.24, r * 0.4, r * 0.2, -0.2, 0, TAU)
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.restore()
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, 0, r * 0.24, r * 0.36, p)
    ellipse(ctx, 0, r * 0.04, r * 0.24, r * 0.36)
    ellipse(ctx, 0, -r * 0.34, r * 0.2, r * 0.18, bodyGradient(ctx, 0, -r * 0.34, r * 0.2, r * 0.18, p))
    drawFace(ctx, 0, -r * 0.35, r * 0.19, species, opts)
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[2]
    ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.025
    for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(d * r * 0.08, -r * 0.48)
      ctx.quadraticCurveTo(d * r * 0.28, -r * 0.72, d * r * 0.36, -r * 0.55)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) ellipse(ctx, 0, -r * 0.05 + i * r * 0.15, r * 0.06, r * 0.06, p[2])
  } else if (shape === 'aquatic') {
    drawTail(ctx, 0, r * 0.05, r * 1.15, species, time, -1)
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, 0, r * 0.46, r * 0.32, p)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(0, bob, r * 0.48, r * 0.32, -0.06, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.1, -r * 0.2)
    ctx.lineTo(0, -r * 0.55)
    ctx.lineTo(r * 0.16, -r * 0.18)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = p[1]
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.2, r * 0.2)
    ctx.lineTo(-r * 0.05, r * 0.45)
    ctx.lineTo(r * 0.12, r * 0.2)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    drawFace(ctx, r * 0.27, -r * 0.02, r * 0.28, species, opts)
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[2]
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.45
    ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.02
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(-r * 0.15, 0, r * (0.12 + i * 0.07), -0.6, 0.6)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  } else if (shape === 'plant') {
    // leaves / legs
    ctx.fillStyle = p[1]
    for (const d of [-1, 1]) {
      ctx.save()
      ctx.translate(d * r * 0.18, r * 0.24)
      ctx.rotate(d * 0.5)
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.ellipse(d * r * 0.16, 0, r * 0.26, r * 0.11, 0, 0, TAU)
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.restore()
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, 0, 0, r * 0.38, r * 0.36, p)
    ellipse(ctx, 0, -r * 0.02, r * 0.38, r * 0.36)
    // petals
    const petals = 5 + stage * 2
    for (let i = 0; i < petals; i++) {
      const a = (i / petals) * TAU + Math.sin(time * 0.6) * 0.04
      ctx.save()
      ctx.rotate(a)
      ctx.fillStyle = i % 2 ? p[0] : p[2]
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.ellipse(0, -r * 0.42, r * 0.14, r * 0.3, 0, 0, TAU)
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.restore()
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    drawFace(ctx, 0, -r * 0.02, r * 0.3, species, opts)
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[1]
    ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.06
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, r * 0.3)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(r * 0.08, r * 0.5, r * 0.02, r * 0.6)
    ctx.stroke()
  } else if (shape === 'serpent') {
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[1]
    ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.22
    ctx.lineCap = 'round'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.34, r * 0.34)
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-r * 0.62, r * 0.02, r * 0.28, r * 0.18, r * 0.12, -r * 0.16)
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-r * 0.02, -r * 0.46, r * 0.3, -r * 0.44, r * 0.34, -r * 0.52)
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.strokeStyle = p[0]
    ctx.lineWidth = r * 0.16
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-r * 0.34, r * 0.34)
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-r * 0.62, r * 0.02, r * 0.28, r * 0.18, r * 0.12, -r * 0.16)
    ctx.bezierCurveTo(-r * 0.02, -r * 0.46, r * 0.3, -r * 0.44, r * 0.34, -r * 0.52)
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.fillStyle = bodyGradient(ctx, r * 0.36, -r * 0.56, r * 0.23, r * 0.2, p)
    ellipse(ctx, r * 0.36, -r * 0.56, r * 0.23, r * 0.2)
    drawFace(ctx, r * 0.4, -r * 0.56, r * 0.2, species, opts)
    drawHorns(ctx, r * 0.36, -r * 0.58, r, species, 0.75)
    ctx.fillStyle = p[2]
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      const t = i / 4
      const sx = -r * 0.1 + t * r * 0.28
      const sy = r * 0.06 - t * r * 0.18
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(sx, sy)
      ctx.lineTo(sx + r * 0.06, sy - r * 0.1)
      ctx.lineTo(sx + r * 0.1, sy)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill()
    }
  }

  drawPattern(ctx, 0, 0, r, species, stage)
  // shimmering top highlight
  ctx.save()
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1 + Math.sin(time * 1.3) * 0.03
  ellipse(ctx, -r * 0.18, -r * 0.4, r * 0.18, r * 0.08, p[2])
  ctx.restore()
}

export function drawCreature(ctx, speciesId, x, y, scale = 1, opts = {}) {
  const species = CREATURE_BY_ID[speciesId]
  if (!species) return
  const time = opts.time ?? performance.now() / 1000
  const r = 52 * scale
  const flip = opts.flip ? -1 : 1
  const alpha = opts.alpha ?? 1
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(x, y)
  ctx.scale(flip, 1)
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha

  if (opts.shadow !== false) {
    ctx.save()
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * 0.28
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, r * 0.62, 0, 0, r * 0.62, r * 0.58)
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,.7)')
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
    ellipse(ctx, 0, r * 0.62, r * 0.55, r * 0.14, g)
    ctx.restore()
  }

  if (opts.aura !== false) aura(ctx, 0, 0, r, species, time, opts.auraIntensity ?? 1)

  if (opts.silhouette) {
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha
    ctx.fillStyle = opts.silhouetteColor || '#0b1020'
    ctx.strokeStyle = opts.silhouetteColor || '#0b1020'
    drawCreatureShape(ctx, species, r, time, { ...opts, facing: 1 })
    ctx.restore()
    return
  }

  drawCreatureShape(ctx, species, r, time, { ...opts, facing: 1 })

  if (opts.sparkles !== false) {
    const n = species.rarity === 'legendario' || species.rarity === 'mitico' ? 8 : species.stage === 2 ? 4 : 2
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const a = time * 0.8 + i * 2.4
      const px = Math.cos(a) * r * (0.6 + (i % 3) * 0.18)
      const py = Math.sin(a * 1.4) * r * 0.6 - r * 0.12
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35 + Math.sin(time * 2 + i * 2) * 0.25
      ellipse(ctx, px, py, r * 0.018, r * 0.018, species.palette[2])
    }
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

const thumbCache = new Map()
export function creatureDataURL(speciesId, size = 128) {
  const key = `${speciesId}_${size}`
  if (thumbCache.has(key)) return thumbCache.get(key)
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
  canvas.width = size
  canvas.height = size
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
  drawCreature(ctx, speciesId, size / 2, size * 0.52, size / 130, { aura: false, shadow: false, sparkles: false, time: 1 })
  const url = canvas.toDataURL('image/png')
  thumbCache.set(key, url)
  return url
}

function drawPine(ctx, x, y, s, color, snow = false) {
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(x, y)
  ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.18)'
  ellipse(ctx, s * 0.12, s * 0.1, s * 0.52, s * 0.13, 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)')
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2a1c'
  ctx.fillRect(-s * 0.035, -s * 0.1, s * 0.07, s * 0.38)
  ctx.fillStyle = color
  for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    const yy = -s * (0.15 + i * 0.24)
    const ww = s * (0.45 - i * 0.1)
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, yy - s * 0.36)
    ctx.lineTo(ww, yy + s * 0.08)
    ctx.lineTo(-ww, yy + s * 0.08)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    if (snow) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(235,248,255,.6)'
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(0, yy - s * 0.36)
      ctx.lineTo(ww * 0.6, yy - s * 0.06)
      ctx.lineTo(-ww * 0.6, yy - s * 0.06)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.fillStyle = color
    }
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawTree(ctx, x, y, s, colors) {
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(x, y)
  ellipse(ctx, s * 0.1, s * 0.14, s * 0.58, s * 0.16, 'rgba(0,0,0,.2)')
  ctx.strokeStyle = colors[1]
  ctx.lineWidth = s * 0.1
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(0, s * 0.2)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-s * 0.04, -s * 0.15, s * 0.06, -s * 0.45)
  ctx.stroke()
  const blobs = [[-0.24, -0.55, 0.3], [0.22, -0.52, 0.28], [0, -0.76, 0.3], [-0.1, -0.38, 0.25]]
  for (const [bx, by, br] of blobs) {
    ctx.fillStyle = colors[Math.abs(Math.floor((bx + by) * 10)) % 2 ? 2 : 3]
    ellipse(ctx, bx * s, by * s, br * s, br * s * 0.78)
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawCrystal(ctx, x, y, s, color, alpha = 1) {
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(x, y)
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha
  ctx.shadowColor = color
  ctx.shadowBlur = s * 0.5
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -s, 0, s)
  g.addColorStop(0, '#ffffff')
  g.addColorStop(0.25, color)
  g.addColorStop(1, shadeColor(color, -70))
  ctx.fillStyle = g
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(0, -s)
  ctx.lineTo(s * 0.35, -s * 0.1)
  ctx.lineTo(s * 0.18, s * 0.55)
  ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.18, s * 0.55)
  ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.35, -s * 0.1)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0
  ctx.globalAlpha = alpha * 0.4
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(0, -s * 0.9)
  ctx.lineTo(s * 0.1, -s * 0.05)
  ctx.lineTo(-s * 0.06, s * 0.2)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.restore()
}

function drawBuilding(ctx, poi) {
  const { x, y } = poi
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(x, y)
  if (poi.type === 'ranch') {
    ellipse(ctx, 0, 42, 120, 25, 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)')
    // fence
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#9b6b3e'
    ctx.lineWidth = 7
    for (let i = -4; i <= 4; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(i * 28, 22)
      ctx.lineTo(i * 28, 58)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-125, 30); ctx.lineTo(125, 30)
    ctx.moveTo(-125, 48); ctx.lineTo(125, 48)
    ctx.stroke()
    // house
    ctx.fillStyle = '#c99558'
    ctx.fillRect(-66, -62, 132, 90)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f2dfb6'
    ctx.fillRect(-54, -48, 108, 65)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#6b3f28'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-82, -62)
    ctx.lineTo(0, -122)
    ctx.lineTo(82, -62)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166'
    ctx.fillRect(-16, -18, 32, 44)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2a1c'
    ctx.fillRect(-12, -14, 24, 40)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#7dd3fc'
    ctx.fillRect(-46, -36, 20, 20)
    ctx.fillRect(26, -36, 20, 20)
    // windmill
    ctx.translate(96, -32)
    ctx.fillStyle = '#e2e8f0'
    ctx.fillRect(-3, -42, 6, 80)
    ctx.save()
    ctx.rotate(performance.now() / 5000)
    for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
      ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 2)
      ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc'
      ctx.fillRect(0, -5, 46, 10)
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.3)'
      ctx.fillRect(6, -3, 36, 4)
    }
    ctx.restore()
  } else if (poi.type === 'arena') {
    ellipse(ctx, 0, 30, 150, 42, 'rgba(0,0,0,.28)')
    const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -100, 0, 50)
    g.addColorStop(0, '#dff8ff')
    g.addColorStop(0.5, '#8bd8e8')
    g.addColorStop(1, '#2d6b7a')
    ctx.fillStyle = g
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(0, 0, 132, 76, 0, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#f8fafc'
    ctx.lineWidth = 9
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.fillStyle = '#0e3a4a'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(0, 4, 92, 46, 0, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#a5f3fc'
    ctx.lineWidth = 4
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(0, 4, 76, 37, 0, 0, TAU)
    ctx.stroke()
    // pillars
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const a = (i / 8) * TAU
      ctx.fillStyle = '#e0f2fe'
      ctx.fillRect(Math.cos(a) * 118 - 4, Math.sin(a) * 64 - 22, 8, 36)
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, -96)
    ctx.lineTo(9, -80)
    ctx.lineTo(0, -70)
    ctx.lineTo(-9, -80)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
  } else if (poi.type === 'village') {
    ellipse(ctx, 0, 40, 130, 28, 'rgba(0,0,0,.24)')
    const tents = [[-64, -6, '#d97706'], [22, -18, '#7c3aed'], [76, 4, '#0e7490']]
    for (const [tx, ty, color] of tents) {
      ctx.fillStyle = color
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(tx - 40, ty + 36)
      ctx.lineTo(tx, ty - 54)
      ctx.lineTo(tx + 40, ty + 36)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.22)'
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(tx, ty - 54)
      ctx.lineTo(tx + 14, ty + 36)
      ctx.lineTo(tx, ty + 36)
      ctx.closePath()
      ctx.fill()
      ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2a1c'
      ctx.fillRect(tx - 9, ty + 12, 18, 24)
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'
    for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(-100 + i * 42, 28 + Math.sin(i) * 8, 3, 0, TAU)
      ctx.fill()
    }
  } else if (poi.type === 'dungeon') {
    ctx.save()
    const glow = 0.4 + Math.sin(performance.now() / 900 + x) * 0.12
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(0, -18, 4, 0, -18, 72)
    g.addColorStop(0, poi.color)
    g.addColorStop(0.45, `${poi.color}55`)
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
    ctx.globalAlpha = glow
    ellipse(ctx, 0, -20, 76, 82, g)
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1b2230'
    ctx.strokeStyle = '#48556b'
    ctx.lineWidth = 8
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(-54, 38)
    ctx.lineTo(-54, -28)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -108, 54, -28)
    ctx.lineTo(54, 38)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.fillStyle = poi.color
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.72
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(0, -4, 35, 50, 0, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    ctx.fillStyle = '#2b3445'
    ctx.fillRect(-66, 32, 22, 34)
    ctx.fillRect(44, 32, 22, 34)
    // runes
    ctx.strokeStyle = poi.color
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7
    ctx.lineWidth = 2
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.arc(0, -6, 12 + i * 7, 0.4 + i, 2.2 + i)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    ctx.restore()
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

let worldCanvas = null
export function buildWorldCanvas() {
  if (worldCanvas) return worldCanvas
  const canvas = document.createElement('canvas')
  canvas.width = WORLD.w
  canvas.height = WORLD.h
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d')
  const rng = seeded(93241)
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0c1820'
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, WORLD.w, WORLD.h)

  // soft biome fields
  for (const zone of ZONES) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(zone.x, zone.y, 0, zone.x, zone.y, zone.r)
    g.addColorStop(0, zone.palette[2])
    g.addColorStop(0.55, zone.palette[1])
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.95
    ctx.fillStyle = g
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(zone.x, zone.y, zone.r, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1

  // terrain speckles
  for (let i = 0; i < 12000; i++) {
    const x = rng() * WORLD.w
    const y = rng() * WORLD.h
    let best = ZONES[0]
    let bd = Infinity
    for (const z of ZONES) {
      const d = Math.hypot(x - z.x, y - z.y) / z.r
      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = z }
    }
    if (bd > 1.25) continue
    const alpha = 0.04 + rng() * 0.1
    ctx.fillStyle = best.palette[2]
    ctx.globalAlpha = alpha
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(x, y, 2 + rng() * 18, 1 + rng() * 7, rng() * TAU, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1

  // river / coastline
  ctx.save()
  const water = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 1500, 0, 2400)
  water.addColorStop(0, '#155e75')
  water.addColorStop(0.5, '#0e7490')
  water.addColorStop(1, '#083344')
  ctx.fillStyle = water
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(0, 2070)
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(480, 1930, 900, 2110, 1320, 2010)
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(1750, 1900, 2180, 2080, 2600, 1980)
  ctx.bezierCurveTo(2900, 1920, 3100, 2040, 3200, 1990)
  ctx.lineTo(3200, 2400)
  ctx.lineTo(0, 2400)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.22
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#c7f5ff'
  ctx.lineWidth = 2
  for (let i = 0; i < 28; i++) {
    const y = 2040 + i * 12
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, y)
    for (let x = 0; x <= 3200; x += 80) ctx.lineTo(x, y + Math.sin(x * 0.01 + i) * 7)
    ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.restore()

  // paths between important places
  const pathPoints = [
    [1290, 1270], [1470, 1530], [1850, 1350], [1500, 1330], [690, 800], [2490, 1060], [1760, 1930], [650, 1690], [1720, 490], [520, 610], [2550, 870], [1870, 2090], [1710, 260], [560, 1850],
  ]
  ctx.save()
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#b08a5a'
  ctx.lineWidth = 24
  ctx.lineCap = 'round'
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.34
  for (let i = 0; i < pathPoints.length - 1; i++) {
    const [x1, y1] = pathPoints[i]
    const [x2, y2] = pathPoints[i + 1]
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo((x1 + x2) / 2 + Math.sin(i) * 60, (y1 + y2) / 2 + Math.cos(i) * 60, x2, y2)
    ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#d4b184'
  ctx.lineWidth = 8
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25
  for (let i = 0; i < pathPoints.length - 1; i++) {
    const [x1, y1] = pathPoints[i]
    const [x2, y2] = pathPoints[i + 1]
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(x1, y1)
    ctx.quadraticCurveTo((x1 + x2) / 2 + Math.sin(i) * 60, (y1 + y2) / 2 + Math.cos(i) * 60, x2, y2)
    ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.restore()

  // biome decoration
  for (const zone of ZONES) {
    if (zone.id === 'bosque') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 260; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU
        const d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r * 0.92
        const x = zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d
        const y = zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d
        if (Math.hypot(x - 1290, y - 1270) < 120 || Math.hypot(x - 520, y - 610) < 140) continue
        const s = 34 + rng() * 44
        drawTree(ctx, x, y, s, ['#1f4a32', '#3b2a1c', '#24573a', '#2f6b43'])
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r
        drawCrystal(ctx, zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d, zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d, 6 + rng() * 8, '#a78bfa', 0.32)
      }
    } else if (zone.id === 'pradera') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 350; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r * 0.95
        const x = zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d, y = zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d
        if (Math.hypot(x - 1290, y - 1270) < 130) continue
        ctx.strokeStyle = rng() > 0.5 ? '#7aa65a' : '#5f8a48'
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55
        ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.moveTo(x, y)
        ctx.quadraticCurveTo(x + 3, y - 7, x + (rng() - 0.5) * 7, y - 13)
        ctx.stroke()
        if (rng() > 0.78) {
          ctx.fillStyle = ['#ffd166', '#fca5a5', '#c4b5fd', '#f8fafc'][Math.floor(rng() * 4)]
          ellipse(ctx, x + 3, y - 12, 2.2, 2.2, ctx.fillStyle)
        }
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    } else if (zone.id === 'desierto') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 55; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r
        const x = zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d, y = zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d
        ctx.strokeStyle = '#e7bd77'
        ctx.globalAlpha = 0.16
        ctx.lineWidth = 2
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.arc(x, y, 16 + rng() * 50, 0.1, 1.9)
        ctx.stroke()
      }
      ctx.globalAlpha = 1
      for (let i = 0; i < 25; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r
        drawCrystal(ctx, zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d, zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d, 8 + rng() * 10, '#fbbf24', 0.28)
      }
    } else if (zone.id === 'cumbre') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 120; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r * 0.95
        const x = zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d, y = zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d
        if (Math.hypot(x - 1710, y - 260) < 120) continue
        drawPine(ctx, x, y, 20 + rng() * 32, '#34536b', true)
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 45; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r
        drawCrystal(ctx, zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d, zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d, 10 + rng() * 12, '#bae6fd', 0.4)
      }
    } else if (zone.id === 'caverna') {
      // rocky cave mouth / boulders
      for (let i = 0; i < 45; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r
        const x = zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d, y = zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d
        ctx.fillStyle = '#29264a'
        ctx.beginPath()
        ctx.ellipse(x, y, 18 + rng() * 30, 12 + rng() * 20, rng() * TAU, 0, TAU)
        ctx.fill()
      }
      for (let i = 0; i < 55; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r
        drawCrystal(ctx, zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d, zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d, 7 + rng() * 16, ['#c084fc', '#7dd3fc', '#fbbf24'][Math.floor(rng() * 3)], 0.55)
      }
    } else if (zone.id === 'costa') {
      for (let i = 0; i < 70; i++) {
        const a = rng() * TAU, d = Math.sqrt(rng()) * zone.r
        drawCrystal(ctx, zone.x + Math.cos(a) * d, zone.y + Math.sin(a) * d, 5 + rng() * 12, '#a5f3fc', 0.28)
      }
    }
  }

  // border cliffs
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#080f16'
  ctx.lineWidth = 110
  ctx.strokeRect(0, 0, WORLD.w, WORLD.h)
  ctx.strokeStyle = '#1a2a33'
  ctx.lineWidth = 10
  ctx.strokeRect(58, 58, WORLD.w - 116, WORLD.h - 116)

  // buildings and dungeon gates
  for (const poi of POIS) drawBuilding(ctx, poi)

  worldCanvas = canvas
  return canvas
}

export function drawPlayer(ctx, x, y, time, dir = 'down', moving = false) {
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(x, y)
  const bob = moving ? Math.sin(time * 9) * 2.5 : Math.sin(time * 2) * 1.2
  const flip = dir === 'left' ? -1 : 1
  ctx.scale(flip, 1)
  ellipse(ctx, 0, 25, 19, 6, 'rgba(0,0,0,.32)')
  // cloak
  const g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, -24, 0, 30)
  g.addColorStop(0, '#2dd4bf')
  g.addColorStop(0.55, '#0f766e')
  g.addColorStop(1, '#134e4a')
  ctx.fillStyle = g
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(-15, -14 + bob)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-24, 14, -17, 26)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 33, 17, 26)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(24, 14, 15, -14 + bob)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fill()
  // scarf
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(-11, -12 + bob)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -8 + bob, 11, -12 + bob)
  ctx.lineTo(9, -5 + bob)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, -1 + bob, -9, -5 + bob)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fill()
  // head
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e9b98e'
  ellipse(ctx, 0, -24 + bob, 11, 11.5, '#e9b98e')
  // hair
  ctx.fillStyle = '#3b2419'
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.arc(0, -26 + bob, 11.5, Math.PI, TAU)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(12, -22 + bob, 8, -18 + bob)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(3, -24 + bob, -2, -18 + bob)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-8, -23 + bob, -11, -18 + bob)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fill()
  // eyes
  ctx.fillStyle = '#111827'
  ellipse(ctx, -4, -23 + bob, 1.5, 1.8, '#111827')
  ellipse(ctx, 4, -23 + bob, 1.5, 1.8, '#111827')
  // lantern
  ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'
  ctx.shadowColor = '#fbbf24'
  ctx.shadowBlur = 12
  ellipse(ctx, 16, 3 + bob, 3.5, 4.5, '#fbbf24')
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0
  ctx.restore()
}

export function drawNPC(ctx, npc, time, near = false) {
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(npc.x, npc.y)
  const bob = Math.sin(time * 1.8 + npc.x) * 1.4
  ellipse(ctx, 0, 22, 17, 6, 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)')
  ctx.fillStyle = npc.color
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(-13, -12 + bob)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-18, 10, -14, 24)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(0, 28, 14, 24)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(18, 10, 13, -12 + bob)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.fillStyle = '#e9b98e'
  ellipse(ctx, 0, -21 + bob, 10, 10.5, '#e9b98e')
  ctx.fillStyle = '#2d1e17'
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.arc(0, -23 + bob, 10.5, Math.PI, TAU)
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.fillStyle = '#111827'
  ellipse(ctx, -3.5, -20 + bob, 1.3, 1.6, '#111827')
  ellipse(ctx, 3.5, -20 + bob, 1.3, 1.6, '#111827')
  // quest marker
  if (near) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166'
    ctx.font = 'bold 18px system-ui'
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'
    ctx.fillText('!', 0, -44 + bob)
  }
  ctx.restore()
}

export function drawWorld(ctx, canvas, state, camera, time, playerMoving) {
  const w = canvas.clientWidth || canvas.width
  const h = canvas.clientHeight || canvas.height
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h)
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h)
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#081018')
  bg.addColorStop(1, '#0d1c20')
  ctx.fillStyle = bg
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)

  const world = buildWorldCanvas()
  ctx.save()
  ctx.translate(-camera.x, -camera.y)
  ctx.drawImage(world, 0, 0)

  // dynamic ground glow around player
  const p = state.player
  const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 4, p.x, p.y, 260)
  glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,209,102,.08)')
  glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,209,102,0)')
  ellipse(ctx, p.x, p.y, 260, 190, glow)

  // dynamic POI labels and pulses
  for (const poi of POIS) {
    if (poi.id === 'dungeon_nexo') continue
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - poi.x, p.y - poi.y)
    if (d > 900) continue
    ctx.save()
    ctx.globalAlpha = clamp(1 - d / 900, 0.2, 1)
    ctx.fillStyle = poi.color
    ctx.font = '600 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui'
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'
    ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,.8)'
    ctx.shadowBlur = 6
    ctx.fillText(poi.name, poi.x, poi.y - 82)
    if (d < 200) {
      const pulse = 0.35 + Math.sin(time * 2.4) * 0.12
      ctx.globalAlpha = pulse
      ctx.strokeStyle = poi.color
      ctx.lineWidth = 2
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.ellipse(poi.x, poi.y + 18, 64, 22, 0, 0, TAU)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
    ctx.restore()
  }

  // NPCs
  for (const npc of state.npcs || []) {
    if (Math.hypot(p.x - npc.x, p.y - npc.y) > 1100) continue
    drawNPC(ctx, npc, time, Math.hypot(p.x - npc.x, p.y - npc.y) < 100)
  }

  // loot
  for (const loot of state.world.loot || []) {
    const bob = Math.sin(time * 2.5 + loot.x) * 4
    ctx.save()
    ctx.translate(loot.x, loot.y + bob)
    ctx.shadowColor = '#fbbf24'
    ctx.shadowBlur = 20
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fbbf24'
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, -14)
    ctx.lineTo(13, -4)
    ctx.lineTo(8, 12)
    ctx.lineTo(-8, 12)
    ctx.lineTo(-13, -4)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.shadowBlur = 0
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff7d6'
    ctx.font = 'bold 11px system-ui'
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'
    ctx.fillText('?', 0, 3)
    ctx.restore()
  }

  // wild creatures
  for (const wild of state.world.spawns || []) {
    if (Math.hypot(p.x - wild.x, p.y - wild.y) > 1200) continue
    const species = CREATURE_BY_ID[wild.speciesId]
    if (!species) continue
    const d = Math.hypot(p.x - wild.x, p.y - wild.y)
    const scale = wild.rare ? 0.46 : 0.4
    drawCreature(ctx, wild.speciesId, wild.x, wild.y + Math.sin(time * 2 + wild.phase) * 2, scale, {
      time: time + wild.phase, flip: wild.vx < 0, shadow: true,
      auraIntensity: wild.rare ? 1.4 : 0.8,
    })
    if (d < 170 || wild.rare) {
      ctx.save()
      ctx.textAlign = 'center'
      ctx.font = '600 11px ui-sans-serif, system-ui'
      ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0,0,0,.9)'
      ctx.shadowBlur = 5
      ctx.fillStyle = wild.rare ? RARITIES[species.rarity].color : '#e2e8f0'
      ctx.fillText(`${species.name} · Nv ${wild.level}`, wild.x, wild.y - 34)
      ctx.restore()
    }
    if (d < 90) {
      ctx.save()
      ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,209,102,.7)'
      ctx.lineWidth = 2
      ctx.setLineDash([5, 5])
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.ellipse(wild.x, wild.y + 15, 30, 12, 0, 0, TAU)
      ctx.stroke()
      ctx.restore()
    }
  }

  drawPlayer(ctx, p.x, p.y, time, p.dir, playerMoving)
  ctx.restore()

  // day/night overlay
  const night = isNight(state.world.time)
  const dusk = state.world.time > 17 && state.world.time < 20
  if (night || dusk) {
    const overlay = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h)
    if (night) {
      overlay.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(5,10,30,.52)')
      overlay.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(10,15,45,.36)')
    } else {
      overlay.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,130,60,.13)')
      overlay.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(90,40,100,.18)')
    }
    ctx.fillStyle = overlay
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
  }

  // vignette
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2, Math.min(w, h) * 0.3, w / 2, h / 2, Math.max(w, h) * 0.72)
  vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
  vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)')
  ctx.fillStyle = vg
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
}

export function drawWeather(ctx, w, h, weather, time, quality = 1) {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h)
  if (!weather || weather === 'clear' || weather === 'none') {
    // drifting motes
    const n = Math.floor(28 * quality)
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 197 + time * (8 + i % 4)) % (w + 100)) - 50
      const y = ((i * 131 + time * 5) % (h + 80)) - 40
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12 + Math.sin(time + i) * 0.05
      ellipse(ctx, x, y, 1.5, 1.5, '#ffd166')
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
    return
  }
  const count = weather === 'rain' ? 160 : weather === 'storm' ? 190 : weather === 'snow' ? 120 : weather === 'sand' ? 100 : 40
  const n = Math.floor(count * quality)
  if (weather === 'rain' || weather === 'storm') {
    ctx.strokeStyle = weather === 'storm' ? 'rgba(170,190,255,.38)' : 'rgba(160,215,255,.35)'
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.2
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 173 + time * 900) % (w + 120)) - 60
      const y = ((i * 271 + time * 1200) % (h + 120)) - 60
      ctx.beginPath()
      ctx.moveTo(x, y)
      ctx.lineTo(x - 6, y + 16)
      ctx.stroke()
    }
    if (weather === 'storm' && Math.sin(time * 3) > 0.985) {
      ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(210,220,255,.35)'
      ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
    }
  } else if (weather === 'snow') {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 151 + time * (25 + i % 15)) % (w + 80)) - 40
      const y = ((i * 211 + time * (45 + i % 22)) % (h + 80)) - 40
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35 + Math.sin(time + i) * 0.18
      ellipse(ctx, x, y, 1.5 + (i % 3), 1.5 + (i % 3), '#f0f9ff')
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  } else if (weather === 'sand') {
    for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 191 + time * 250) % (w + 160)) - 80
      const y = ((i * 101 + Math.sin(time + i) * 40 + time * 60) % (h + 80)) - 40
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.12 + (i % 5) * 0.03
      ellipse(ctx, x, y, 14 + (i % 9) * 4, 2.5, '#f5cf87')
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  } else if (weather === 'fog') {
    for (let i = 0; i < 9; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 230 + time * 16) % (w + 500)) - 250
      const y = (i * 97 + Math.sin(time * 0.4 + i) * 60) % h
      const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(x, y, 0, x, y, 240)
      g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(200,215,225,.075)')
      g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(200,215,225,0)')
      ellipse(ctx, x, y, 260, 120, g)
    }
  } else if (weather === 'eclipse') {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2, 0, w / 2, h / 2, Math.max(w, h) * 0.8)
    g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(80,20,140,.04)')
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(20,0,45,.34)')
    ctx.fillStyle = g
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
    for (let i = 0; i < 55; i++) {
      const x = ((i * 137 + time * 20) % (w + 80)) - 40
      const y = ((i * 211 + time * 15) % (h + 80)) - 40
      ctx.globalAlpha = 0.2 + Math.sin(time * 2 + i) * 0.12
      ellipse(ctx, x, y, 1.8, 1.8, '#e9d5ff')
    }
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  }
}

export function drawBattleBackground(ctx, w, h, zoneId, weather, time) {
  const zone = ZONE_BY_ID[zoneId] || ZONES[0]
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h)
  const isEclipse = weather === 'eclipse'
  if (isEclipse) {
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#12061f')
    sky.addColorStop(0.6, '#2c1147')
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#070b18')
  } else if (zoneId === 'desierto') {
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#3d1f14')
    sky.addColorStop(0.55, '#9a5a2b')
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#2a160e')
  } else if (zoneId === 'cumbre') {
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#0c1e35')
    sky.addColorStop(0.6, '#315b78')
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#101c2a')
  } else if (zoneId === 'caverna') {
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#0b0b18')
    sky.addColorStop(0.6, '#1e1838')
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#0a0914')
  } else if (zoneId === 'costa') {
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#082532')
    sky.addColorStop(0.55, '#126f85')
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#071820')
  } else {
    sky.addColorStop(0, '#0b1c2a')
    sky.addColorStop(0.55, '#1f4b4a')
    sky.addColorStop(1, '#0c1b18')
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = sky
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)

  // distant mountains / structures
  ctx.save()
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.55
  for (let layer = 0; layer < 3; layer++) {
    ctx.fillStyle = ['#08131a', '#0b1d24', '#0e2a2d'][layer]
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.moveTo(0, h * 0.62)
    const seg = 7
    for (let i = 0; i <= seg; i++) {
      const x = (i / seg) * w
      const y = h * (0.38 + layer * 0.07) + Math.sin(i * 1.9 + layer) * 50 + (i % 2) * 25
      ctx.lineTo(x, y)
    }
    ctx.lineTo(w, h * 0.7)
    ctx.lineTo(0, h * 0.7)
    ctx.closePath()
    ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.restore()

  // arena floor
  const floor = ctx.createRadialGradient(w * 0.5, h * 0.82, 20, w * 0.5, h * 0.82, w * 0.62)
  floor.addColorStop(0, zone.palette[2])
  floor.addColorStop(0.5, zone.palette[1])
  floor.addColorStop(1, '#061014')
  ctx.fillStyle = floor
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.ellipse(w * 0.5, h * 0.86, w * 0.62, h * 0.28, 0, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.strokeStyle = zone.accent
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.25
  ctx.lineWidth = 2
  for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(w * 0.5, h * 0.84, w * (0.12 + i * 0.1), h * (0.05 + i * 0.035), 0, 0, TAU)
    ctx.stroke()
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1

  // floating dust / weather
  for (let i = 0; i < 45; i++) {
    const x = ((i * 137 + time * (12 + i % 5)) % (w + 40)) - 20
    const y = ((i * 211 + Math.sin(time + i) * 20) % (h * 0.7))
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.08 + (i % 5) * 0.02
    ellipse(ctx, x, y, 1.5 + (i % 3), 1.5 + (i % 3), zone.accent)
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1

  // vignette
  const vg = ctx.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2, Math.min(w, h) * 0.2, w / 2, h / 2, Math.max(w, h) * 0.75)
  vg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
  vg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,.55)')
  ctx.fillStyle = vg
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
}

export function drawMinimap(ctx, state, w, h) {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h)
  const bg = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, w, h)
  bg.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(8,20,24,.92)')
  bg.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(12,30,38,.92)')
  ctx.fillStyle = bg
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
  const sx = w / WORLD.w
  const sy = h / WORLD.h
  for (const zone of ZONES) {
    ctx.fillStyle = zone.palette[2]
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.35
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(zone.x * sx, zone.y * sy, zone.r * sx, zone.r * sy, 0, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8
    ctx.fillStyle = zone.accent
    ctx.font = '8px system-ui'
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'
    ctx.fillText(zone.short, zone.x * sx, zone.y * sy + 2)
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  for (const poi of POIS) {
    if (poi.type === 'dungeon' && poi.id === 'dungeon_nexo') continue
    ctx.fillStyle = poi.color
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(poi.x * sx, poi.y * sy, 2.5, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
  }
  const px = state.player.x * sx
  const py = state.player.y * sy
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166'
  ctx.shadowColor = '#ffd166'
  ctx.shadowBlur = 8
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.arc(px, py, 3.5, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,209,102,.45)'
  ctx.lineWidth = 1
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.arc(px, py, 7 + Math.sin(performance.now() / 400) * 2, 0, TAU)
  ctx.stroke()
}

export function drawMap(ctx, state, w, h) {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h)
  const bg = ctx.createRadialGradient(w / 2, h / 2, 40, w / 2, h / 2, w * 0.7)
  bg.addColorStop(0, '#10242c')
  bg.addColorStop(1, '#060d14')
  ctx.fillStyle = bg
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
  const sx = w / WORLD.w
  const sy = h / WORLD.h
  for (const zone of ZONES) {
    const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(zone.x * sx, zone.y * sy, 0, zone.x * sx, zone.y * sy, zone.r * sx)
    g.addColorStop(0, zone.palette[2])
    g.addColorStop(0.6, zone.palette[1])
    g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
    ctx.fillStyle = g
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.9
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.ellipse(zone.x * sx, zone.y * sy, zone.r * sx, zone.r * sy, 0, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.08)'
  ctx.lineWidth = 1
  for (let i = 1; i < 8; i++) {
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(i * w / 8, 0); ctx.lineTo(i * w / 8, h); ctx.stroke()
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, i * h / 8); ctx.lineTo(w, i * h / 8); ctx.stroke()
  }
  for (const zone of ZONES) {
    ctx.fillStyle = '#f8fafc'
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.72
    ctx.font = '600 13px ui-sans-serif, system-ui'
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'
    ctx.fillText(zone.name, zone.x * sx, zone.y * sy - zone.r * sy * 0.62)
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3
    ctx.font = '10px ui-sans-serif'
    ctx.fillText(zone.subtitle, zone.x * sx, zone.y * sy - zone.r * sy * 0.62 + 16)
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  }
  for (const poi of POIS) {
    if (poi.type === 'dungeon' && poi.id === 'dungeon_nexo') continue
    const x = poi.x * sx, y = poi.y * sy
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(5,12,18,.85)'
    ctx.strokeStyle = poi.color
    ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
    ctx.beginPath()
    ctx.arc(x, y, 8, 0, TAU)
    ctx.fill()
    ctx.stroke()
    ctx.fillStyle = poi.color
    ctx.font = '10px system-ui'
    ctx.textAlign = 'center'
    ctx.fillText(poi.icon, x, y + 3.5)
    ctx.font = '9px ui-sans-serif'
    ctx.fillStyle = '#dbeafe'
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.8
    ctx.fillText(poi.name, x, y + 21)
    ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  }
  const px = state.player.x * sx
  const py = state.player.y * sy
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166'
  ctx.shadowColor = '#ffd166'
  ctx.shadowBlur = 14
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.arc(px, py, 5, 0, TAU)
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.shadowBlur = 0
  ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,209,102,.55)'
  ctx.lineWidth = 1.5
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.arc(px, py, 11 + Math.sin(performance.now() / 350) * 3, 0, TAU)
  ctx.stroke()
}

export function drawRanchScene(ctx, w, h, time) {
  const sky = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, h)
  sky.addColorStop(0, '#0d2330')
  sky.addColorStop(0.5, '#1c4a4c')
  sky.addColorStop(1, '#081418')
  ctx.fillStyle = sky
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
  // stars
  for (let i = 0; i < 50; i++) {
    const x = (i * 137) % w
    const y = (i * 71) % (h * 0.55)
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(time + i) * 0.15
    ellipse(ctx, x, y, 1.2, 1.2, '#f8fafc')
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  // hills
  ctx.fillStyle = '#16352d'
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(0, h * 0.62)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w * 0.3, h * 0.5, w * 0.55, h * 0.63)
  ctx.quadraticCurveTo(w * 0.78, h * 0.72, w, h * 0.58)
  ctx.lineTo(w, h)
  ctx.lineTo(0, h)
  ctx.fill()
  // house silhouette
  ctx.fillStyle = '#0b1b1d'
  ctx.fillRect(w * 0.68, h * 0.42, w * 0.2, h * 0.26)
  ctx.beginPath()
  ctx.moveTo(w * 0.65, h * 0.43)
  ctx.lineTo(w * 0.78, h * 0.3)
  ctx.lineTo(w * 0.91, h * 0.43)
  ctx.closePath()
  ctx.fill()
  ctx.fillStyle = '#ffd166'
  ctx.globalAlpha = 0.7
  ctx.fillRect(w * 0.73, h * 0.49, w * 0.035, h * 0.06)
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1
  // fireflies
  for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) {
    const x = (i * 173 + Math.sin(time * 0.5 + i) * 40) % w
    const y = h * 0.62 + Math.sin(time * 1.3 + i * 2) * h * 0.12
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.3 + Math.sin(time * 2 + i) * 0.25
    ellipse(ctx, x, y, 1.6, 1.6, '#ffd166')
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1
}

export function drawTitleGlow(ctx, w, h, time) {
  const g = ctx.createRadialGradient(w * 0.5, h * 0.52, 0, w * 0.5, h * 0.52, w * 0.5)
  g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(45,212,191,.16)')
  g.addColorStop(0.5, 'rgba(45,212,191,.04)')
  g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(0,0,0,0)')
  ctx.fillStyle = g
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h)
  for (let i = 0; i < 80; i++) {
    const x = (i * 173 + Math.sin(time * 0.3 + i) * 60) % w
    const y = (i * 97 + time * (4 + i % 7)) % h
    ctx.globalAlpha = 0.1 + Math.sin(time + i) * 0.08
    ellipse(ctx, x, y, 1.4, 1.4, i % 3 ? '#5eead4' : '#fbbf24')
  }
  ctx.globalAlpha = 1
}

export function elementColor(element) {
  return ELEMENTS[element]?.color || '#94a3b8'
}

let current = 'es'
try {
  const saved = localStorage.getItem(LANG_KEY)
  if (SUPPORTED.includes(saved)) current = saved
} catch {}

export function getLang() { return current }
export function setLang(lang) {
  if (!SUPPORTED.includes(lang)) return current
  current = lang
  try { localStorage.setItem(LANG_KEY, lang) } catch {}
  document.documentElement.lang = lang
  window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('nexo:lang', { detail: { lang } }))
  return current
}
export function toggleLang() { return setLang(current === 'es' ? 'en' : 'es') }
export function otherLang() { return current === 'es' ? 'en' : 'es' }
export function t(key, vars = {}) {
  let value = STRINGS[current]?.[key] ?? STRINGS.es[key] ?? key
  for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(vars)) value = value.replaceAll(`{${k}}`, String(v))
  return value
}
export function elementName(el) { return current === 'en' ? (ELEMENT_EN[el] || el) : (ELEMENTS[el]?.name || el) }
export function rarityName(r) { return current === 'en' ? (RARITY_EN[r] || r) : (RARITIES[r]?.name || r) }
export function weatherName(w) { return current === 'en' ? (WEATHER_EN[w]?.[0] || w) : (WEATHERS[w]?.name || w) }
export function weatherDesc(w) { return current === 'en' ? (WEATHER_EN[w]?.[1] || '') : (WEATHERS[w]?.desc || '') }
export function localizedChapter(chapter) {
  if (!chapter) return null
  if (current === 'en' && CHAPTER_EN[chapter.id]) return { ...chapter, ...CHAPTER_EN[chapter.id] }
  return chapter
}
export function localizedSideQuest(q) {
  if (!q) return null
  if (current === 'en' && SIDE_EN[q.id]) return { ...q, ...SIDE_EN[q.id] }
  return q
}
export function localizedSideQuestById(id) { return localizedSideQuest(SIDEQUEST_BY_ID[id]) }
export function chapterTitle(id) { return localizedChapter(CHAPTERS[id])?.title || '' }

## Objective
- Build a complete 2D Monster Rancher-style browser game with 150+ creatures, evolutions, traps, open world, weather, dungeons, story/sidequests, PvP arena/invites, and a Spanish-inclusive language selector.
- Final game must be reviewed for runtime errors and delivered as an Android `.apk`.

## Requirements
- 2D creature-collection game with epic creature detail, infinite leveling, per-level techniques, and evolutions.
- Weather changes, open world, explorable dungeons, and rare items that improve gameplay.
- Free exploration, online PvP arena plus invitation-based duels, random/time-dependent encounters.
- Long story with sidequests and 150+ creatures including evolutions.
- Capture via traps, with trap options based on creature level and rarity.
- Creature rarities from Common to Legendary, with strengths and weaknesses.
- Spanish language included in a language selector.
- Must work without errors and ship as an Android `.apk`.
- User speaks Spanish; game UI/content should default to Spanish.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a static HTML/CSS/JS browser game using Canvas 2D, no external assets/frameworks.
- 50 evolutionary families × 3 stages = 150 creatures, plus 8 mythic creatures = 158 total.
- Spanish default UI with English translations for interface and chapter/sidequest titles/objectives; creature names/lore remain Spanish.
- PvP matchmaking is simulated locally; invitation duels work asynchronously via encoded share codes/URLs because the build is static.
- Android APK planned via installed Android SDK/Gradle tooling, not yet implemented.
- LocalStorage used for saves and language preference.
- Working files are currently uncommitted.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/data.js`: full data set for 158 creatures, 10 elements, rarities, 226 techniques, traps, items, relics, zones, POIs, NPCs, 10 story chapters, 15 sidequests, trainers, weather, dungeons.
- `src/core.js`: shared utilities, creature creation/recalculation, XP, type effectiveness, invite encoding, stat helpers.
- `src/art.js`: procedural creature art for 10 body archetypes, world pre-render, player/NPC drawing, weather particles, battle backgrounds, minimap/world map, title/ranch scenes.
- `src/engine.js`: world simulation, spawning, weather/events, movement, interactions, capture, battle engine, XP/levels/evolutions, quests, ranch actions, shop, dungeons, arena, invite duels, saves.
- `src/i18n.js`: Spanish/English dictionaries, language switching, localized chapter/sidequest labels.
- `styles.css`: complete title screen, HUD, modals, ranch/codex/journal/map/arena/dungeon/battle styling, responsive/mobile rules.
- Syntax checks passed for `data.js`, `core.js`, `art.js`, and `engine.js`.
- Duplicate creature names were cleaned up.
- Android SDK is available at `/usr/local/lib/android/sdk`; Java and Gradle are installed.

### Active
- Creating `index.html`, `src/main.js`, and the full UI/controller layer to connect engine, art, and i18n.
- Then browser verification, bug fixing, and APK packaging.

### Blocked
- None currently.

## Next Move
1. Create `index.html` with all required DOM IDs/classes referenced by the planned UI: title, starter screen, HUD, quest tracker, minimap, party/action docks, joystick, toast stack, modal root, battle overlay/canvas, loading screen.
2. Create `src/main.js` and likely `src/ui.js` to bind all screens, buttons, modals, battle rendering, canvas loop, keyboard/touch controls, language switching, and event bus handlers.
3. Serve the static app, run browser checks/screenshots, and exercise new game → starter → world → battle → capture → ranch/codex/map/dungeon/arena flows.
4. Fix all console/runtime errors and visual/responsive issues.
5. Add Android wrapper/package (Capacitor or plain WebView project), build `.apk`, and verify it exists.
6. Update `README.md` with run/build instructions and final summary.

## Relevant Files
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/engine.js`: core gameplay logic; exports `game`, `bus`, `emit`, `on`.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/data.js`: all game content and IDs; 158 creatures.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/art.js`: all Canvas rendering functions used by UI/main.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/core.js`: helpers imported by engine/art/UI.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/src/i18n.js`: `t`, `setLang`, `toggleLang`, localization helpers.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/styles.css`: all visual styling; expects specific DOM class names.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/README.md`: currently generic project readme, needs game instructions.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/start.sh`: default runtime launcher; static `index.html` is supported.
- `/home/runner/work/PlayGround/PlayGround/.gitignore`: ignores `screenshots/`, `node_modules/`, etc.

## Important Context
- `engine.js` exports `game`, `freshState`, `bus`, `emit`, `on`, `SHOP_STOCK`.
- Key engine methods available to UI: `newGame(name, starterId)`, `loadGame()`, `hasSave()`, `save()`, `update(dt)`, `movePlayer(dx,dy,dt,sprint)`, `nearestInteractable()`, `interactNearest()`, `startWildBattle(uid)`, `playerMove(moveId)`, `playerItem(itemId,targetUid)`, `playerSwitch(uid)`, `playerCapture(trapId)`, `playerFlee()`, `finishBattle()`, `startArenaBattle()`, `createInvite()`, `acceptInvite(code)`, `enterDungeon(id)`, `moveDungeon(x,y)`, `exitDungeon()`, `evolveCreature(uid)`, `trainCreature(uid)`, `equipRelic(uid,relicId)`, `buy(kind,id,qty)`, `teleport(poiId)`.
- Engine emits events: `game:start`, `game:loaded`, `toast`, `save:ok`, `weather:change`, `world:event`, `zone:change`, `battle:start`, `battle:finished`, `story:chapter`, `level:up`, `creature:evolved`, `capture:success`, `dungeon:enter`, `dungeon:node`, `dungeon:floor`, `dungeon:cleared`, `dungeon:failed`.
- Battle events returned by actions: `log`, `attack`, `heal`, `buff`, `debuff`, `miss`, `status`, `statusDamage`, `faint`, `switch`, `captureThrow`, `captureSuccess`, `captureFail`, `item`, `flee`, `turn`, `end`.
- UI should call `game.finishBattle()` after battle end animation and then render `battle:finished` rewards.
- `engine.js` has a known bug to fix: `resolveDungeonBattle` marks a dungeon node resolved even when the result is `fled`; it should only resolve on `win`.
- RARITIES catch values currently: common 1.0, uncommon 0.86, rare 0.72, epic 0.52, legendary 0.32, mythic 0.18.
- Player starts at ranch area around `x=1290,y=1370`; starter IDs are `brasal-1`, `aquil-1`, `brot-1`.
- `POIS` includes hidden `dungeon_nexo` at `(1500,1110)`, unlocked at main chapter 9.
- `game.update(dt)` should only run during world exploration, not battle/dungeon/modal.
- No `package.json` exists; static server can serve `index.html` directly. Android build will need its own wrapper project outside or inside repo.

## Objective
- Build a complete 2D Monster Rancher-style browser game with 150+ creatures, evolutions, traps, open world, weather, dungeons, story/sidequests, PvP arena/invites, and a Spanish-inclusive language selector.
- Final game must be reviewed for runtime errors and delivered as an Android `.apk`.

## Requirements
- 2D creature-collection game with epic creature detail, infinite leveling, per-level techniques, and evolutions.
- Weather changes, open world, explorable dungeons, and rare items that improve gameplay.
- Free exploration, online PvP arena plus invitation-based duels, random/time-dependent encounters.
- Long story with sidequests and 150+ creatures including evolutions.
- Capture via traps, with trap options based on creature level and rarity.
- Creature rarities from Common to Legendary, with strengths and weaknesses.
- Spanish language included in a language selector.
- Must work without errors and ship as an Android `.apk`.
- User speaks Spanish; game UI/content should default to Spanish.
- User instructed: "No finalices el proyecto sin consultarme" — do not declare the project finished without checking with the user.

## Decisions
- Implemented as a static HTML/CSS/JS browser game using Canvas 2D, no external assets/frameworks.
- 50 evolutionary families × 3 stages = 150 creatures, plus 8 mythic creatures = 158 total.
- Spanish default UI with English translations for interface and chapter/sidequest titles/objectives; creature names/lore remain Spanish.
- PvP matchmaking is simulated locally; invitation duels work asynchronously via encoded share codes/URLs because the build is static.
- Android APK planned via installed Android SDK/Gradle tooling, not yet implemented.
- LocalStorage used for saves and language preference.
- Working files are currently uncommitted.

## Work State
### Completed
- `src/data.js`: full data set for 158 creatures, 10 elements, rarities, 226 techniques, traps, items, relics, zones, POIs, NPCs, 10 story chapters, 15 sidequests, trainers, weather, dungeons.
- `src/core.js`: shared utilities, creature creation/recalculation, XP, type effectiveness, invite encoding, stat helpers.
- `src/art.js`: procedural creature art for 10 body archetypes, world pre-render, player/NPC drawing, weather particles, battle backgrounds, minimap/world map, title/ranch scenes.
- `src/engine.js`: world simulation, spawning, weather/events, movement, interactions, capture, battle engine, XP/levels/evolutions, quests, ranch actions, shop, dungeons, arena, invite duels, saves.
- `src/i18n.js`: Spanish/English dictionaries, language switching, localized chapter/sidequest labels.
- `styles.css`: complete title screen, HUD, modals, ranch/codex/journal/map/arena/dungeon/battle styling, responsive/mobile rules.
- `index.html`: full DOM structure for title, starter, HUD, quest tracker, minimap, party/action docks, joystick, toast stack, modal root, battle overlay, loading screen.
- `src/ui-core.js`: generic UI helpers, toasts, modal system, HUD/party/quest rendering, title/starter flow, static text localization, help modal, core bindings.
- `src/ui-panels.js`: story, ranch, codex, journal, map, inventory, shop, NPC dialog, discovery, battle rewards, settings, dungeon modals.
- `src/ui-arena.js`: arena rank/stats/leaderboard, simulated matchmaking, invite code creation/copy/accept.
- `src/ui.js`: orchestrator for menus, interactions, camping, event-bus wiring, pending story/dungeon queues.
- `src/battle.js`: battle overlay rendering, move/action UI, trap/item/switch subpanels, event animation, result handling, reward handoff.
